name: Nicole Vigil
prior_offices: Big Horn County treasurer (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Nicole Vigil is the Big Horn County treasurer and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The Lovell Chronicle reported that she ran unopposed after winning the Republican primary, and quoted her remarks at Gina Anderson's January 2026 retirement recognition.
